info.title: Quotameter HTTP API
info.description: The internal HTTP API of the Quotameter web service (spec §13). Every request and response is defined by the same TypeBox contracts the server validates through, and every error answers the common envelope `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }` with stable codes. All state-changing requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) require the dedicated nonstandard header, and a JSON content type whenever the request carries a body (spec §15.3); CORS is disabled. See docs/api.md for the human-readable reference.

get.description: The one endpoint that answers without authentication in every auth mode (spec §13, §15.1). The unauthenticated response is exactly `{ "status": "ok" }`; no diagnostics ride it.
Service state plus every account's §7.3 status, last successful collection, and last error (message redacted against the account's secret). Timestamps are epoch milliseconds.

post.description: Composes §15.2 end to end: the per-source failed-attempt budget (increasing delays, never rejections — an over-budget attempt is answered slowly with the same envelope, and the slept delay is clamped to a transport-safe ceiling), scrypt verification, the session mint, and the `Set-Cookie` header (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api; Secure when the client-facing leg is HTTPS). One attempt per source address runs at a time; a same-source request arriving while another is in flight answers the same 401 under `source-busy` without being verified. The route is public in the §15.1 sense (the credential-presenting client has no session yet), so `UNAUTHENTICATED` here is the wrong-or-absent-password verdict, not the mode guard’s demand. Repeated logins mint fresh sessions; a passwordless configuration answers 401 fail-closed.

parameters.name: X-Quotameter-Request
parameters.description: Required on every state-changing request (spec §15.3): a value with at least one non-whitespace character; not interpreted.

200.description: A session was established; the session cookie is set and `expiresAt` is its row’s effective expiry.

expiresAt.description: The session row's effective expiry as epoch milliseconds — the instant from which the §15.2 verdict rejects the cookie (half-open, D-124).

post.summary: Revoke the session and clear the cookie
post.description: Session-bound and idempotent: revokes the session row named by the presented cookie and answers the clear-cookie twin (`Max-Age=0`) whether or not a live row was deleted. Under a password-demanding §15.1 verdict a request without a valid session answers 401 before the handler. Carries no body, so the §15.3 mutation header is its only extra requirement.

parameters.name: X-Quotameter-Request
parameters.description: Required on every state-changing request (spec §15.3): a value with at least one non-whitespace character; not interpreted.

200.description: Whether a live session was revoked; the cookie is cleared either way.

revoked.description: Whether a live session row was deleted; the cookie is cleared either way (logout is idempotent).

sessionCookie.name: quotameter_session
sessionCookie.description: Session cookie of the password modes (spec §15.1/§15.2). Passwordless loopback access in `auto` mode needs no credential; every operation except the health probe and login is otherwise authenticated.
